description: 1 negative : glass ; 8 x 10 in. or smaller | Photograph shows a cat named Timmie owned by Bascom N. Timmons, journalist and president of the National Press Club; with a canary named Caruso which belonged to President Calvin Coolidge. Coolidge gave Caruso to Timmons because the two pets were friends. (Source: researcher J. Mangin, 2018)
